cohort: Pregnant women in the United States from the 2007-2011 Nationwide Inpatient Sample, including 69,385 women with epilepsy and 20,449,532 women without epilepsy
finding: Women with epilepsy had a significantly higher risk of death during delivery hospitalization (80 deaths per 100,000 pregnancies) compared to women without epilepsy (6 deaths per 100,000 pregnancies).
mod_finding: Women with epilepsy had an increased risk of cesarean delivery compared to women without epilepsy.
